title: GTasks Todo Manager Configuration
description: Schema for OAuth credentials and multi-account configuration storage

oauth.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials from Google Cloud Console

clientId.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from Google Cloud Console

clientSecret.description: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret from Google Cloud Console

redirectUri.description: OAuth redirect URI, defaults to localhost for desktop apps

displayName.description: User's display name from Google profile

tokens.description: OAuth tokens for this account (encrypted at rest)

refreshToken.description: Refresh token for obtaining new access tokens (encrypted)

expiresAt.description: Access token expiration timestamp (Unix epoch ms)

scope.description: OAuth scopes granted for this account

addedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when account was added

lastUsed.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last API call with this account

defaultAccount.description: Email of default account for operations

outputFormat.description: Default output format for CLI commands

encryptionKeyPath.description: Path to encryption key file for token storage

projects.description: Git repository to Google Tasks list associations. Keys are normalized git URIs (e.g., 'owner/repo' or 'gitlab.com/owner/repo')

name.description: Display name for the project (usually the repository name)

taskListId.description: Google Tasks list ID associated with this project

taskListTitle.description: Full title of the Google Tasks list (e.g., '[Project] owner/repo')

accountEmail.description: Google account email that owns the task list

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this association was created
